dispositions.reuse: an existing module already meets the acceptance; the task adds a regression test and evidence only

dispositions.new: no equivalent exists; the task adds a module at the stated path
dispositions.blocked: needs something this environment or the user has not provided (people, licensed media, an application run, a public API)
